# MDL603 · `client-group-overridden`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

An extra file makes the MySQL client library ignore the defaults file's [client].

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | connection |
| Default severity | warning |
| Fix | — |
| Design references | F14, C2 |
| Proven on real mydumper by | [`mdl603-extra-file-tool-group-overrides-client`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl603-extra-file-tool-group-overrides-client.txtar), [`mdl603-extra-file-client-group-overrides-client`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl603-extra-file-client-group-overrides-client.txtar), [`mdl603-control-extra-file-without-tool-or-client-group`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl603-control-extra-file-without-tool-or-client-group.txtar) |

## Why

mydumper hands one file to the MySQL client library for the connection. The extra file (`--defaults-extra-file`) replaces the defaults file in that role when it has a [mydumper] or [client] section, or when GLib rejects it. The library then reads that file only: the [client] section of the defaults file, its host, user and password, is ignored. Only load sets (design §9.3) let mydumper-lint see both files.

## Example

The defaults file, `defaults.cnf` (`--defaults-file`):

```ini
[client]
host=db
user=backup
```

❌ Before, the extra file (`--defaults-extra-file`):

```ini
[mydumper]
threads=4
```

```text
1:2-1:10 warning MDL603[client-group-overridden] this extra file becomes the MySQL client library's defaults file because it has a [mydumper] section: the [client] section of defaults.cnf (line 1) is ignored
  = The connection uses only this file's settings: the host, user and password of the defaults file's [client] do not apply.
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL603: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL603` on the line above it.
